description: Force reconciliation of one instance so its recorded state is re-derived from what the host actually reports. Use when an instance's status looks wrong or stale — for example, running in our records but gone on the host. Requires expected_version and an idempotency key. Corrects bookkeeping only: it does not start, stop, or move the workload, and it changes nothing about what the instance is billing.
name: reconcile_instance
